Bengal Bypoll Sees BJP Seeking Muslim Votes, Mamata Backing Congress

In the context of a bypoll in Nandigram, West Bengal, the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is reportedly seeking the trust of Muslim voters to demonstrate minority support for the state government. Concurrently, Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee has backed the Congress in the same Nandigram bypoll, a move that signals a potential shift in Bengal politics.
